defs.def: a number representing a particular amount, especially one given in official information （代表数量，尤指官方资料中的）数字

ex.s: Drinks now contain 45 million fewer kilos of sugar as a result of manufacturers' efforts to avoid the charge, according to Treasury figures.
ex.t: 自4月以来，饮料公司必须根据含糖量为他们生产或进口的每升含糖饮料支付18至24便士。

ex.s: Indeed official figures suggest the country has shrunk by 5% since 1993 and people in Russia live a shorter life now than those in 1961.
ex.t: 事实上，官方数据显示，该国自1993年以来已缩减了5%，俄罗斯人的寿命现在比1961年时更短。

ex.s: It's important to read its title to know what the facts and figures represent, to read the labels along the vertical and horizontal sides, and to look at and understand the key information.
ex.t: 阅读标题以了解这些事实和数据代表什么，阅读垂直和水平轴上的标签，并看明白关键信息，这些都很重要。

defs.def: a symbol rather than a word representing one of the numbers between 0 and 9 数字符号；字码；位数
the area of mathematics that deals with adding, multiplying, etc. numbers 算术
a person of the type mentioned 人物；人士

ex.s: A British woman who won a S1 million prize after she was named the World's Best Teacher will use the cash to bring inspirational figures into UK schools.
ex.t: 一名英国女性在被评上世界最佳教师后赢得了100万美元奖金，她将用这笔钱把励志人物带进英国学校。

ex.s: The programme brought his actions to public attention, and Winton became a respected figure around the world.
ex.t: 这个节目使他的行为引起了公众的关注，温顿因此在全世界成为了一位受人尊敬的人物。

defs.def: the shape of a person seen from a distance or not clearly （远处人的）轮廓；（隐约可见的）人影

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.
ex.t: 所有参与者都必须探讨通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活质量。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备或飞往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是科学知识的应用，用以解决问题，以无数方式触动生活。

defs.def: the shape of the human body, especially a woman's body that is attractive 身材；体形；（尤指）身段

ex.s: She realized she looked like a child, with her tiny figure.
ex.t: 她意识到自己身材娇小，看起来像个孩子。

defs.def: a person or an animal in a drawing, painting, etc., or in a story （绘画或故事中的）人，动物

ex.s: Facts and figures.
ex.t: 事实与数据。

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.
ex.t: 此外，约50%的世界人口生活在生育率目前低于替代水平（即每名女性2.1个孩子）的地区，几乎所有发达国家都在经历低于替代水平的生育率。

ex.s: We figured that in twenty years each of us ought to have our destiny worked out and our fortunes made, whatever they were going to be.”“It sounds pretty interesting,” said the policeman.
ex.t: 我们想，二十年后，我们每个人都应该已经确定了自己的命运，并且发了财，不管结果会是什么。＂＂听起来挺有意思的，＂警察说。

ex.s: Research has found that learning obtained from a well-told story is remembered more accurately, and for far longer, than from facts and figures.
ex.t: 研究发现，从一个讲述精彩的故事中学到的东西，比从事实和数据中学到的记得更准确，也持久得多。

ex.s: The study showed the animals had figured out how to apply what they learned about human faces during training to new faces in the testing stage.
ex.t: 研究表明，这些动物已经想出了如何把训练时学到的关于人脸的知识，运用到测试阶段的新面孔上。

ex.s: Many people go crazy trying to figure out how to spend time with friends, family, work, play, etc ____13____ Find ways to enjoy them in a combined manner.
ex.t: 许多人疯狂地想办法如何安排时间与朋友、家人、工作、娱乐等共度。____13____ 找到方法以组合的方式享受它们。

defs.def: a statue of a person or an animal （人、动物的）雕像，塑像
a picture, diagram, etc. in a book, that is referred to by a number （书中的）图，表
a particular shape formed by lines or surfaces 图形
a pattern or series of movements performed on ice （冰上表演动作的）花样
to be part of a process, situation, etc. especially an important part 是重要部分；是 … 的部分

ex.s: When learning about a new topic, it is important to collect facts and figures.
ex.t: 在了解新主题时，收集事实和数据非常重要。

ex.s: I figured whoever lost the dog was probably just as    59   to it as I am to my dogs,” says Ehlers.
ex.t: 埃勒斯说：“我想，不管是谁丢了这只狗，大概也会像我珍惜我的狗一样____59____它。”

defs.def: to think or decide that sth will happen or is true 认为，认定（某事将发生或属实）

ex.s: With the right combination of animals and plants, he figured, maybe he could clean up waste the way nature did.
ex.t: 他想，通过正确的动植物组合，也许他能像大自然那样清理废物。

ex.s: But then I figured I'd better just go all out and see what happens.
ex.t: 但后来我想我最好全力以赴，看看会发生什么。

defs.def: to calculate an amount or the cost of sth 计算（数量或成本）

ex.s: It is difficult to figure out a global population of polar bears as much of the range has been    62   (poor) studied; however, biologists calculate that there are about 20,000-25,000 polar bears worldwide.
ex.t: 很难弄清北极熊的全球数量，因为其大部分活动范围___62___（poor）被研究；不过，生物学家估算全球约有20,000至25,000只北极熊。

defs.def: to think about sb/sth until you understand them/it 弄懂；弄清楚；弄明白

ex.s: If you don’t understand something, you may research, study, and talk to other people _______ you figure it out.
ex.t: 如果你不理解某样东西，你可以去研究、学习，并与其他人交流，直到你弄明白为止。

ex.s: That’s why this issue (期) of Writer’s Digest aims to help you figure out how to write the best ending for whatever kind of writing you’re doing.
ex.t: 所以本期《作家文摘》旨在帮助你弄清楚如何为你正在写的任何类型的作品写出最好的结局。

ex.s: I read both definitions over again, trying to figure it out, but Miss Chevalier must have read my mind.
ex.t: 我把两个释义又读了一遍，试图弄明白，但谢瓦利埃小姐一定看穿了我的心思。

ex.s: They figure out what they are good at. ___36___ The hedgehog concept makes perfect sense for companies.
ex.t: 他们弄清楚自己擅长什么。___36___刺猬理念对公司来说完全合理。

ex.s: I’ve learned a few things along the way though, which I hope you’ll find encouraging if you’re doing your best to figure out how you can make the change in a not-always-supportive household.
ex.t: 不过，在这一过程中我学到了一些东西，如果你正努力在一个并非总是支持你的家庭里弄清楚如何做出改变，我希望这些能给你鼓励。

ex.s: Figure It Out!-Playing with Math
ex.t: 《搞明白！——玩转数学》

ex.s: Figure It Out!-Playing with Math.
ex.t: 《搞明白！——玩转数学》。

ex.s: When you were trying to figure out what to buy for the environmentalist on your holiday list, fur probably didn’t cross your mind.
ex.t: 当你在为假期名单上的环保主义者挑选礼物时，毛皮可能根本不会出现在你的脑海中。

ex.s: To figure out how much power these devices are using, Callie Babbitt and her colleagues at the Rochester Institute of Technology in New York tracked the environmental costs for each product throughout its life — from when its minerals are mined to when we stop using the device.
ex.t: 为了弄清楚这些设备用了多少电，纽约罗彻斯特理工学院的 Callie Babbitt 和她的同事们追踪了每种产品整个生命周期的环境成本——从矿物开采到我们停止使用该设备为止。

ex.s: To help us figure out the meaning Budget Line.
ex.t: 帮助我们弄明白预算线的含义。

ex.s: Behind it, the person is trying to figure out who exactly I teach…the animals?
ex.t: 在那眼神背后，对方是在努力弄清楚我到底教谁……教动物吗？

defs.def: to calculate an amount or the cost of sth 计算（数量或成本）
